judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiology data into BIDS, likely used to format this dataset; it does not describe the sham neurofeedback VR EEG data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
